App information, version, developer and technical specifications
Modern Spanish-Persian vocabulary learning system based on spaced repetition, adaptive 4-option quizzes, offline Room database, and modern Gemini AI design.
Install Yadin for scientific spaced-repetition Spanish vocabulary learning:\nhttps://github.com/manidigit/Yadin
Yadin is built upon the Ebbinghaus forgetting curve. Review intervals (daily, weekly, monthly) are timed right before you are likely to forget, moving words into permanent memory.
Choose between classic 4-stage Leitner, dynamic SM-2 Easiness Factor, or modern FSRS memory stability (DSR).
Words are categorized into 4 difficulty tiers. The system automatically adjusts difficulty based on consecutive answer streaks and selects smarter quiz distractors.
Over 7,300 practical Spanish words with TTS audio pronunciation, Excel/CSV import, and full JSON backup & restore.
Step-by-step onboarding, review algorithms (Yadin, SM-2, FSRS), and app features
Yadin is a scientific, 100% offline vocabulary system designed to transfer Spanish words into your long-term memory. If you just installed the app, follow these 3 simple steps:
In Settings, choose your study direction (Spanish to Persian or reverse) and your preferred scheduling engine (Yadin Classic, SM-2, or modern FSRS).
Go to the Review tab, select your practice mode (Flashcard or 4-Option Quiz) and session size (e.g., 20, 50, or 100 words).
Simply tap Start! The app automatically prioritizes overdue words first, fills remaining slots with new words, and schedules each word\'s next review date.
You can switch between these three scientific scheduling engines anytime in Settings:

In this classic structured method, words move across 4 boxes:
• Daily: Initial learning, reviewed the next day (1 day)
• Weekly: After a correct Daily review, due in 7 days
• Monthly: After a correct Weekly review, due in 30 days
• Learned: After a correct Monthly review, moved to long-term memory
⚠️ Golden Rule: Any wrong answer (even in Monthly or Learned) immediately resets the word back to the Daily box.

With SM-2, you no longer need to manually pick Daily, Weekly, or Monthly! Just select "SM-2 Smart Review" and tap Start:
• Dynamic Easiness Factor (EF): Each word has its own EF (starting at 2.5) that adapts to your recall quality.
• Exponential Intervals: 1st review = 1 day, 2nd = 6 days, and subsequent reviews multiply the previous interval by EF (e.g., 6 → 15 → 38 days).
• 4 Rating Buttons on Flashcards: Rate your recall as Again, Hard, Good, or Easy with live day previews above each button.

The world's most advanced modern spaced repetition scheduler, operating in a unified smart queue ("FSRS Smart Review"):
• 3-Component Memory Model (DSR): Tracks Memory Stability (S), inherent Difficulty (D from 1 to 10), and Retrievability (R) for every single word.
• Desired Retention Rate: Configurable in Settings between 85% (fewer reviews), 90% (balanced default), and 95% (maximum retention). At 90%, a word becomes due right when your recall probability drops to 90%.
• Delay-Aware Adaptation: If you review a word late after several days off and still remember it, FSRS rewards you with a larger stability boost.
How New Words, Due Words & Mastery Work
What happens behind the scenes when you start a 50- or 100-word session?
The engine first selects words you have practiced before whose due date (nextReviewDay) is today or earlier, prioritizing the most overdue words first.
If you request 50 words and only 20 due words are waiting today, the remaining 30 slots are automatically filled with new unpracticed words.
Any word you review today is locked until tomorrow, so running multiple sessions in the same day will never repeat words you already practiced today.
When Is a Word Marked as "Learned"?

In Yadin mode after passing Monthly, and in SM-2 or FSRS as soon as a word\'s next interval exceeds 30 days, it automatically becomes "Learned" and leaves the daily queue so you can focus on new words.

Switch seamlessly between two study modes:\n• Interactive Flashcards: View the prompt word, listen to audio pronunciation, tap to flip in 3D for translations/notes, and grade your recall.\n• Adaptive 4-Option Quiz: Distractors are generated using spelling similarity, category overlap, and difficulty across 3 challenge levels (Beginner, Normal, Professional) with full question navigation.

Every word has 4 difficulty tiers (Easy, Medium, Hard, Very Hard):\n• Automatic Adjustment: By default, 3 consecutive correct answers make a word one tier easier, while 3 consecutive mistakes make it harder (configurable from 2 to 5 in Settings).\n• Targeted Practice: Filter your review sessions to practice only Hard or Very Hard words.

Recognizing a Spanish word and recalling a Spanish word from Persian are distinct cognitive skills. Yadin tracks stages, SM-2/FSRS parameters, and difficulty completely independently for Normal and Reverse directions.
Advanced Library, Batch Import & Smart Audit

Access over 7,295 curated words across 12 topic categories:
• Accent-Insensitive Search & 4 Filters: Search without typing Spanish accents and filter by status, stage, difficulty, or category.
• Single & Batch Import: Add words manually or import from Excel (.xlsx), CSV, TXT, or clipboard.
• Smart Audit: Automatically detect and merge duplicates while keeping your highest learning progress.

Monitor your memory health in the Progress tab:
• 360° Memory Retention Gauge & Category Mastery.
• Proportional Capsule Activity Chart across 7, 30, and 90 days.
• Upcoming Due Forecast (tomorrow, 3 days, 7 days), Golden Study Hours, and 20 tiered achievements.

From Settings → Backup & Restore, export all your vocabulary, Leitner stages, SM-2 & FSRS states, review history, and settings to JSON or Excel (CSV), and restore anytime with Smart Merge or Clean Replace.
